take: Dallas announced it has placed forward Oskar Bäck on injured reserve. He has been a fourth-line forward who kills penalties and plays about 11 minutes a night, and the Stars have already played one game without him. In that game Joel Kiviranta took his spot beside Faksa and Blackwell, and Tyler Seguin's ice time rose to 17:04 a night from 15:02. Bäck had one assist in seven games, and the Stars' share of the quality chances at five-on-five was 3.4 points better with him off the ice.
